notes: Trigger transaction CDRA reads the trigger queue and replies on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT. The request is 'INQA' plus an 11-digit account id (REQUEST-MSG-COPY); the module README's 'ACCT' plus request id layout does not match the code. Signed amounts are moved to zoned S9(10)V99 fields, so the reply shows the overpunched last digit ('{' is +0). Pinned but not observable here: 2300-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE sets REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN and 2400 sets RESP-QUEUE-OPEN (lines 245 and 279, swapped flag names), and the error text is 'CICS RETREIVE' (line 200).
